1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000020_ERENVILLE
1.description: On the far side of that great bridge unfolded the wilds of Shaaloani─“where the sun guides” in the Shetona tongue.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000030_ERENVILLE
2.description: A harsh guide, to be sure, with its blazing rays scorching the land and hardening its inhabitants.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000040_ERENVILLE
3.description: But sweeping change had come to the arid expanse when, beneath its red crust, vast deposits of ceruleum were discovered.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000050_ERENVILLE
4.description: Embracing this opportunity, Vow Koana's supporters hurtle on, driven by dreams of a future illuminated by blue flame.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000060_ERENVILLE
5.description: It is here that our journey continues, our path taking us along wending roads of steel. Each length of track a declaration of hope─and ambition.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000070_ERENVILLE
6.description: My home, Yyasulani, lies past Shaaloani.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000080_ERENVILLE
7.description: It will be a long journey, but the railroad should make it easier.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000100_ERENVILLE
9.description: As for the way to the train station, let's ride these fellows, shall we?

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000110_ERENVILLE
10.description: Well, well... It's become a proper town.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000150_ZEKOWA
14.description: (-Hot-headed Youth-)I'm talking to you, you old bastard!

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000170_WIHUWTE
16.description: (-Frustrated Gentleman-)For the last time, the investigation is closed. There's no refuting the evidence.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000180_ZEKOWA
17.description: (-Hot-headed Youth-)I don't give a shit about your evidence, you lying scum! You release my friends, or I'll make you wish you had!

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000190_WIHUWTE
18.description: (-Frustrated Gentleman-)Let me remind you who the scum is here.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000200_WIHUWTE
19.description: (-Frustrated Gentleman-)Your friends, who had the temerity to point their firearms at me, the deputy chief of the Dustwatch.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000210_WIHUWTE
20.description: (-Frustrated Gentleman-)And after taking them into custody, what should we discover but incontrovertible proof that they had committed larceny.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000220_WIHUWTE
21.description: (-Frustrated Gentleman-)They will not be released until they've paid for their crimes.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000230_ERENVILLE
22.description: I'd heard a peacekeeping force had been formed to deal with growing lawlessness. Seems the situation is bad indeed.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000240_HHUSATAHWIAUDA
23.description: Still kicking up a fuss, eh? Sounds like poor Zekowa needs his bottle.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000250_HHUSATAHWIAUDSB
24.description: Sure he wouldn't prefer his mama's teat?

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000290_ZEKOWA
28.description: Treat me like a child, will you!? My friends haven't done anything wrong, damn it! They've been framed!

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000310_WIHUWTE
30.description: (-Frustrated Gentleman-)Listen here, Zekowa. If you want to be treated like an adult, then you'd best comport yourself like one. That means respecting the rule of law.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000320_WIHUWTE
31.description: (-Frustrated Gentleman-)Order may be precarious here in Shaaloani, but it can be had if each man does the right thing. And for those that don't, well─they have to answer to the Dustwatch.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000330_WIHUWTE
32.description: (-Frustrated Gentleman-)Now run along, and think before you cast aspersions next time.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000350_ZEKOWA
34.description: Fine... If that's how it's gonna be...

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000380_ESTINIEN
37.description: There's a time to fight and a time to withdraw. For you, that's now.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000410_KEMAKKA
40.description: (-Concerned Hhetsarro-)What are you doing, Zekowa? You better not be stirring up trouble!

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000420_ZEKOWA
41.description: Wihuwte, you sack of rroneek shit! This ain't over, you hear me!?

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000430_KEMAKKA
42.description: (-Concerned Hhetsarro-)You want to tell me what that was about?

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000440_WIHUWTE
43.description: Nothing that need concern you, sir. Zekowa is simply struggling to come to terms with the low character of his friends.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000450_WIHUWTE
44.description: But for good measure, I'll have the men keep an eye on him.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000470_WIHUWTE
46.description: Now, if you'll excuse me, I'll go make my rounds.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000480_ESTINIEN
47.description: I wasn't expecting to see your faces among the crowd.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000490_ESTINIEN
48.description: Talk is rife there's a new Dawnservant. I take it you've found it, then─the golden city.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000500_ERENVILLE
49.description: Aye, the contest is over. And as I needed to return home to Yyasulani, I offered to show our friend some of Xak Tural.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000520_ESTINIEN
51.description: Nothing in particular. Just seeing what there is to see.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
53.description: Going wherever the wind blows, eh?

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000530_ESTINIEN
55.description: Gulool Ja Ja compensated me rather generously for our duel. I'll be able to enjoy a comfortable life on the road for the foreseeable future.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000540_ESTINIEN
56.description: But for now, I shall be moving on.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000550_ESTINIEN
57.description: Oh, by the way─I recommend you try the sabotender. They may not look it, but they're surprisingly delicious.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000570_ZEKOWA
59.description: Wihuwte! Finally caught up to me, I see.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000580_WIHUWTE
60.description: Well, well, if it isn't our young outlaw.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000590_WIHUWTE
61.description: You've taken up stealing, I'm told. Can't say I'm surprised about that, but I am surprised that you'd offer yourself up to be arrested!

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000600_ZEKOWA
62.description: Sorry to disappoint, but you're the one who's going to answer for their crimes today.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000630_WIHUWTE
66.description: So you found the stolen goods. That's fine work.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000640_ERENVILLE
67.description: This barrel was at Sheshenewezi Springs, mixed in with others bound for Tuliyollal.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000650_ERENVILLE
68.description: The Landsguard would've presumed it part of the regular ceruleum shipments and waved it through. And once it reached its destination, it would have been retrieved, and its contents sold for coin.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000660_KEMAKKA
69.description: The audacity... Do we know who's behind this?

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000670_ERENVILLE
70.description: As fortune would have it, I spied the leader of this operation being handed one of the stolen items.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000680_ERENVILLE
71.description: A bracelet, which Vow Wuk Lamat had intended for her nursemaid Namikka.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000690_WIHUWTE
72.description: I-It was from the Vow of Resolve!?

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000710_WIHUWTE
74.description: No! N-No, never! And if I knew who had it, I-I would've arrested the scoundrel!

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
76.description: You would've had to arrest yourself.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
77.description: Oh, come off it. I saw you with the bracelet.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000720_KEMAKKA
78.description: What's the meaning of this, Wihuwte?

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000730_WIHUWTE
79.description: I-It's a set up, sir! I...I have the bracelet, y-yes, but I─only 'cause I found it, I-I swear!

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000740_WIHUWTE
80.description: They're the real criminals! They concocted this scheme to frame me─so they could get me out of the picture!

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000750_ZEKOWA
81.description: If you feel your honor's at stake, there's always the old-fashioned way.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000760_ZEKOWA
82.description: The law which folks have used to settle their differences for generations.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000780_ZEKOWA
84.description: Wihuwte─I challenge you to a duel.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000790_ZEKOWA
85.description: The winner is right. The loser is wrong. Doesn't get simpler than that.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000810_HHUSATAHWIMALEA
88.description: Let your pistols do the talking!

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000820_WIHUWTE
89.description: Please. Do you honestly believe you can goad me into playing your game?

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000830_ZEKOWA
90.description: You refuse, then? Hmph. A baby alpaca's got more fight than you!

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000840_WIHUWTE
91.description: All right, boy. But remember─you asked for this.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000850_HHUSATAHWIMALEA
92.description: Come on, Zekowa! Give him what for!

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000860_VIGILANTEMALEA
93.description: Shouldn't we stop them, Chief? Even if it's just rubber bullets, we're in the middle of town...

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000890_ZEKOWA
98.description: Looks like you've gotten slow in your old age...Vulture.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000900_KEMAKKA
99.description: You and I are going to have a long talk.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000910_ZEKOWA
100.description: I apologize for dueling in the middle of town. If you want to lock me up, then lock me up.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000920_ZEKOWA
101.description: But please, let my friends go. They've done nothing wrong.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000930_KEMAKKA
102.description: You drew your gun within town limits.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000940_KEMAKKA
103.description: But Wihuwte drew first. Far as I'm concerned, you acted in self-defense. You're free to go.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000960_ZEKOWA
105.description: Hah, you're not such a bad guy after all!

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000970_KEMAKKA
106.description: Just a man of the wilds, like you.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000980_KEMAKKA
107.description: But to think that Wihuwte had taken control of the Daybreakers... It pains me that it happened right under my nose.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_000990_ZEKOWA
108.description: What are you gonna do about his crew? Some of them are still in Tonatenyawi.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001000_KEMAKKA
109.description: Those who have broken the law will be taken into custody.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001010_KEMAKKA
110.description: But those who haven't will be given the chance to resume walking the strait and narrow.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001020_KEMAKKA
111.description: What about you, Zekowa? What do you intend to do now?

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001040_ZEKOWA
113.description: Protect the weak and help the helpless─the old-fashioned way!

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001050_KEMAKKA
114.description: Here. This was Vow Wuk Lamat's gift for someone, wasn't it?

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001060_ERENVILLE
115.description: Yes, a person very dear to her.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001070_KEMAKKA
116.description: I suppose this is where we go our separate ways. My thanks again for your help apprehending the Vulture.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001080_SHENZA
117.description: (-Railroad Engineer-)I'm so sorry, but we're not sure when the train will be running again.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001090_SHAALOANIPASSENGER
118.description: You've got to be joking! Of all the places to get stuck at on the way...

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001100_SHENZA
119.description: (-Railroad Engineer-)Please don't tell me you've come to complain too!

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001110_ERENVILLE
120.description: We heard that the earthquake had caused disruptions and wanted to ask when operations would resume. But I see that it will be a while yet.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001120_SHENZA
121.description: (-Railroad Engineer-)I'm afraid so. Too few hands for too much work.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001130_SHENZA
122.description: (-Railroad Engineer-)It's time-consuming enough to inspect the tracks after every quake, but this last one we got after the succession ceremony was massive. Made a mess of a whole bunch of railroad ties.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001140_ERENVILLE
123.description: The succession ceremony? We would have been in Tuliyollal at the time.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001150_ERENVILLE
124.description: If it was as violent as you say, we should have felt it as well.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001160_SHENZA
125.description: (-Railroad Engineer-)I have to admit it was a touch strange, having seen my fair share of tremors. If I had to describe it, it felt more like the rumbling from an explosion.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001170_ERENVILLE
126.description: Is there anything I can do to help?

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001190_ERENVILLE
128.description: What about you, my friend? If you'd rather strike out on your own, I understand.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001200_SHENZA
129.description: (-Railroad Engineer-)Though if you were willing to lend us a hand, too, we'd be truly, tremendously grateful!

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001210_SHENZA
130.description: Thank you! Thank you so much! I'm Shenza, by the way. Pleasure to make your acquaintance.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001220_SHENZA
131.description: If you would please step inside, I can introduce you to everyone!

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001230_ERENVILLE
132.description: Sorry for dragging you into this.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001250_SHENZA
135.description: Wawlika is our stationmaster, and over there is our top driver, Nitowikwe.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001260_SHENZA
136.description: And this grizzled mug is Zawpya, an engineer who joined around the same time as me.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001270_WAWLIKA
137.description: Much obliged for the help. I'll make it worth your while, I promise.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
140.description: Would you happen to be a fan of trolleys...?

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001290_WAWLIKA
142.description: Trolleys? They're fine, I suppose, but they're no match for our ceruleum-powered engine!

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001300_ZAWPYA
143.description: She's absolutely glorious, let me tell you! If you'd like to bask in her beauty, you should visit the depot behind the platform.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001310_SHENZA
144.description: Oh? For a moment, it looked to me like you were just dying to say something.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001320_WAWLIKA
145.description: We all have our secrets. Best not to pry.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001330_WAWLIKA
146.description: Right then. What I'd like you two to do is help us procure timber.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001340_WAWLIKA
147.description: We'll be using it to fashion new railroad ties, so it needs to be the strongest stuff we can get.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001350_WAWLIKA
148.description: In these parts, that means the trees in the Pyariyoanaan Plain. It is Hhetsarro territory, though, so we need to get their permission first.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001360_WAWLIKA
149.description: Come on, no time to waste!

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001380_ERENVILLE
151.description: A glorious, grand machine indeed... I hope Namikka was able to secure a seat.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001390_WAWLIKA
153.description: Thanks to you, we managed to resume service much faster than anticipated. You have our gratitude.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001400_SHENZA
154.description: Ahhh, there's nothing so enchanting as a ceruleum-powered engine in motion!

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001410_ZAWPYA
155.description: Ain't that the truth. Don't think I'll ever tire of watching them chugging along. They make wagons look like toys.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001420_SHENZA
156.description: And so long as we can lay the tracks, she can go on and on and on. Before you know it, she'll be crossing the entire continent!

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001430_WAWLIKA
157.description: Railroads are a somewhat recent addition to Tural. As it stands, we can only ferry folks as far as Yyasulani.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001440_WAWLIKA
158.description: And from an operational standpoint, we still have much to learn. There's always some problem or another to deal with.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001450_WAWLIKA
159.description: But we'll keep working at it. We'll hone our craft and continue expanding till, one day, our trains are running coast-to-coast. That's the ultimate dream.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001460_WAWLIKA
160.description: Goodness, I completely lost track of time. By now, I expect the train will be nearing Yyasulani.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001470_WAWLIKA
161.description: When it returns, we'll see you on your way. So if you've got any preparations to make, you'd better make 'em quick.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001510_SHENZA
165.description: What in the flying─ What's happening!?

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001520_ZAWPYA
166.description: The train! Nitowikwe and the others!

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001530_ERENVILLE
167.description: My home lies that way as well...

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001550_ERENVILLE
169.description: What in the world... Are they heading for Tuliyollal!?

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
171.description: We need to get back right away!

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
172.description: We need to follow that airship!

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001570_WUKLAMAT
174.description: You're here! Good, good─they came from the sky and attacked without any warning.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001620_ALISAIE
179.description: I don't know what they are...but they're not men!

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001710_BAKOOLJAJA
193.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Save the thanks─just get to safety!

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001720_BAKOOLJAJA
194.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I'll hold the line here! Fall back to the palace!

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001730_BAKOOLJAJA
195.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Quickly, before it's overrun!

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001760_BAKOOLJAJA
198.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)This is simply how I do things now.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001770_BAKOOLJAJA
199.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)So, who wants to taste my blade next!?

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001800_KOANA
202.description: By the gods... What has happened to you?

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001810_WUKLAMAT
203.description: This is your butchery, isn't it?

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001820_WUKLAMAT
204.description: After everything you've done in service to the throne, how could you betray us!?

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001830_ZORAALJA
205.description: My demand is simple: the dissolution of Tuliyollal and surrender of all its territories.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001840_ZORAALJA
206.description: Refuse, and I will kill every last one of you.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001870_ZORAALJA
209.description: To teach the masses the folly of war that they cry out for peace, and thus unite the world.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001880_GULOOLJAJA
210.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)What has changed you so much, and in so short a time?

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001890_GULOOLJAJA
211.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)To harm the very people you swore to serve...

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001900_GULOOLJAJA
212.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)This is an unforgivable deed─committed by my son! My <hex:021A020203>son<hex:021A020103>!

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001920_GULOOLJAJA
214.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)And you will have my answer...

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001930_GULOOLJAJA
215.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)By my hands, I will end your madness.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001940_WUKLAMAT
216.description: Papa, wait! I should be the one to do this!

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001950_GULOOLJAJA
217.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)No. His sins are mine to bear.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001960_KOANA
218.description: Fear not. While Zoraal Ja is strong, he has never been Father's equal in combat.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_001970_ZORAALJA
219.description: I believed you long dead. To have the chance to kill you myself is an unforeseen blessing.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002040_GULOOLJAJA
226.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)Farewell, Zoraal Ja, my son... And forgive me...

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002080_ZORAALJA
230.description: Despite his old age, the mighty Gulool Ja Ja remains a fearsome foe indeed.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002090_ZORAALJA
231.description: You retain the vitality of two souls despite the passing of one.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002170_ZORAALJA
240.description: You are no match for me.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002180_WUKLAMAT
241.description: Murderer! On my honor as Vow of Resolve, I'll make you pay!

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002190_ZORAALJA
242.description: So the once faint-hearted girl would live up to her title.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002200_ZORAALJA
243.description: Very well. If only to demonstrate the disparity between us, I give you a chance to prove yourself.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002210_ZORAALJA
244.description: Rally the entirety of your strength. Lay siege to my kingdom.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002220_ZORAALJA
245.description: Strike me down, like I did Father. Then will you be his worthy successor.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002240_ZORAALJA
247.description: My warships will remain in your skies.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002250_ZORAALJA
248.description: When you fail to prove your worth, I shall order them to lay waste to Tuliyollal.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002280_KOANA
251.description: Father, please! You can't give up!

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002300_KETENRAMM
253.description: I'm right here. I'm right here.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002330_KETENRAMM
256.description: I'm an old fossil like you. I've only got so many years left.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002340_KETENRAMM
257.description: But if that's what you want, it would be an honor.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002350_GULOOLJAJA
258.description: You and I...must go on another journey together someday...

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002360_KETENRAMM
259.description: Aye, ye can count on it.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002400_GULOOLJAJA
263.description: The graves of the Yok Huy... You saw them, yes? I always found their teachings comforting...

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002420_KOANA
265.description: Please, Father, you must save your strength.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002430_GULOOLJAJA
266.description: Our flesh may wither and die. But so long as we are remembered, we are never truly gone.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002440_GULOOLJAJA
267.description: Through you, my hopes survive... Through you, I live on...

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002450_GULOOLJAJA
268.description: So do not mourn me. Walk tall...and see our nation to a brighter future.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002510_ALISAIE
274.description: There you are, Lamaty'i! I was beginning to─

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002520_WUKLAMAT
275.description: Come on. Come on, take it. Please!

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002570_ALISAIE
280.description: You need rest, you and <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> both. I will tend to this soul.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002580_WUKLAMAT
281.description: But my people... I have to help them...

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002590_ALISAIE
282.description: The Landsguard have matters well in hand. Trust in them.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002600_ALISAIE
283.description: If there's another attack, your people will need you to protect them. They'll need you to be sharp.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002610_ALISAIE
284.description: So please, rest. Consider it your duty.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002620_WUKLAMAT
285.description: I stood before them all... Said that we'd build a nation where everyone knows happiness...

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002640_WUKLAMAT
287.description: What good is a Vow of Resolve who cannot save her people!?

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
290.description: You won't save your people by brooding.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002660_WUKLAMAT
292.description: You're right. This isn't the time for sulking.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002670_WUKLAMAT
293.description: Thank you. My head's a little clearer now. I need to concentrate on what I can do rather than what I can't.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002680_WUKLAMAT
294.description: We've dealt with unfriendly factions before. From Yok Huy still longing for conquest to adherents of blessed siblings─people who were unwilling to listen.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002690_WUKLAMAT
295.description: Even so, I believed that by learning about one another and engaging in good faith, we could peacefully settle our differences. And we did.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002700_WUKLAMAT
296.description: But my brother is different. There'll be no reasoning with him. He killed our people─our father. He'll stop at nothing to achieve his goal.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002710_WUKLAMAT
297.description: What's more, he has power. The power to destroy the peace we've worked so hard to preserve.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002720_WUKLAMAT
298.description: If I'm to protect that peace, then I must fight...

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002730_WUKLAMAT
299.description: I must confront Zoraal Ja─and kill him!

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002750_WUKLAMAT
301.description: And thank you for taking charge in the relief effort. We would've fared far worse without you.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002760_ALISAIE
302.description: Someone had to do it, that's all. Come, let's take stock.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002770_WUKLAMAT
303.description: In terms of casualties, at least fifty died in the attack, and many times that number are wounded. All available healers are seeing to their care.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002780_WUKLAMAT
304.description: Structural damage, at least, is limited, so essential business can be conducted without issue.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002790_WUKLAMAT
305.description: That said, the people are understandably shaken. We must assuage their fears and begin working to restore things to normal as quickly as possible.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002800_KOANA
306.description: Now, the most confounding mystery remains our enemy...

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002810_KOANA
307.description: And their mechanical soldiers created with technology that surpasses anything I've ever seen...

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002820_KOANA
308.description: What is their nature? And how did Zoraal Ja manage to bring them under his command? Such things remain unknown.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002830_ERENVILLE
309.description: They emerged from the dome encasing Yyasulani, we're quite certain of that much.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002840_WUKLAMAT
310.description: Ah, speaking of the dome, we have some theories, I'm told.

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002850_KRILE
311.description: Indeed. I would like to call upon some helpers to join the discussion. May I invite them here?

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002870_KRILE
313.description: It's me. Permission has been granted. You can come in.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002910_YSHTOLA
317.description: After that long voyage, I had hoped that we might be afforded a moment's rest, but I gather circumstances are quite dire.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002920_GRAHATIA
318.description: All is well at the annex, never fear. I've already dealt with the most pressing matters, and others hold the fort in my absence.

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002930_KRILE
319.description: Following the changing of Dawnservants, Gulool Ja Ja spoke about the golden city to his two successors.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002940_KRILE
320.description: Thanks to Wuk Lamat, I was allowed to attend that meeting.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002941_KRILE
321.description: What I heard led me to conclude that this was a matter for the Students. Thus did I call upon our comrades, who possess the requisite expertise.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002950_KRILE
322.description: It was actually after that that the dome manifested. But based on what we know, I have reason to believe that it is connected to the golden city.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002960_YSHTOLA
323.description: While we're eager to help, we have limited familiarity with the situation. Might we trouble you to explain from the beginning?

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002970_KRILE
324.description: As you know, it was a letter I found tucked away in the Baldesion Annex that brought me to Tural.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002980_KRILE
325.description: A letter from the Dawnservant addressed to my grandfather, sent some twenty years ago.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_002990_ALPHINAUD
326.description: The request to investigate the city of gold.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003000_KRILE
327.description: Indeed. The strange thing is, there was mention of neither Tural nor the city in our records.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003010_KRILE
328.description: Hoping to learn the truth of my grandfather's mission─what he did and saw─I volunteered to help in the rite of succession.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003020_KRILE
329.description: At the end of which, I was able to hear the tale from Gulool Ja Ja.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003040_KRILE
331.description: Like us, my grandfather went to the deepest chamber of the Skydeep Cenote. And like us, he saw the gate to the golden city.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003050_GRAHATIA
332.description: Is that what you required our help with? This gate?

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003060_KRILE
333.description: It was. You see, the gate was opened once in the past, and...

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003080_KETENRAMM
335.description: I can take the story from here. Considerin' my part in these affairs, I reckon maybe I'm best equipped to speak on the matter.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003090_KETENRAMM
336.description: I was there too, you see. In those ruins, together with Galuf and Gulool Ja Ja. And what I saw that day, I'll never forget...

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003110_GALUF
338.description: I cannot help but wonder if the structures in this part of the ruins were built by a completely different civilization.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003120_GULOOLJAJA
339.description: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)It was over a thousand years ago that the giants mined here.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003130_GULOOLJAJA
340.description: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)Their records make no mention of glowing stones.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003150_GALUF
342.description: It harbors high concentrations of aether. And on the surface are what appear to be arcane patterns.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003160_GALUF
343.description: They aren't Allagan or Mhachi or Nymian. If anything, they put me in mind of the calculations of the south sea islanders. But even then...

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003180_GULOOLJAJA
345.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)What did you do?

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003210_GULOOLJAJA
348.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)None of this has ever happened before...

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003240_GALUF
351.description: Now hold on... Why would you...

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003260_GULOOLJAJA
353.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)What is this? Who are you?

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003270_KETENRAMM
354.description: Though it never opened again, Galuf continued to study the gate for years after that, hopin' to learn somethin' of value.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003280_KETENRAMM
355.description: All he could conclude was that it was built with unknown technology, and that it led to another world. One apart from the void.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003281_KETENRAMM
356.description: We'd assumed the ruins themselves were the golden city, only to discover that the real prize actually lay beyond the gate─and beyond our reach.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003290_KETENRAMM
357.description: Couldn't make head nor tail of the artifact either.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003300_KETENRAMM
358.description: As it had similar properties to the black stone in the ruins, we were convinced it was important, so Gulool Ja Ja took it to the palace for safekeepin'.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003310_KETENRAMM
359.description: Galuf, meanwhile, took the baby with him back to Sharlayan and raised her as his own.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003330_KRILE
361.description: The earring inside the letter to my grandfather... It was apparently found amongst my swaddling clothes.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003340_ALPHINAUD
362.description: If this is true, then it means that you hail from another reflection...

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003350_KRILE
363.description: So it would seem. I still struggle to take it all in myself.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003360_KRILE
364.description: Looking back, Grandfather was always quick to seek distractions whenever I broached the subject. But never would I have guessed anything like this...

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003370_KRILE
365.description: But enough about me. We have more pressing matters.

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003380_YSHTOLA
366.description: The forces that assailed Tuliyollal─you suspect they are somehow connected to the golden city?

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003390_ALISAIE
367.description: Thinking back on it, the soldiers looked like they could've been made from the same black stone.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003400_KETENRAMM
368.description: And leadin' them was Zoraal Ja... His involvement also lends weight to the theory.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003410_KETENRAMM
369.description: On the day of the succession ceremony, a bandit took me unawares and knocked me out.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003420_KETENRAMM
370.description: When I came to, I found my home turned upside down, with a few particular items missin'.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003430_KETENRAMM
371.description: Namely, the keystones I was entrusted with for my role as watcher of the gate.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003440_ALPHINAUD
372.description: The bandit─you believe that it was...?

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003450_KETENRAMM
373.description: I only got a glimpse of 'em, but aye. It was a blue-scaled Hoobigo. I know of no other.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003460_KOANA
374.description: The artifact stored at the palace was also stolen. The thief struck during the ceremony, when the guard was spread thin.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003470_ALPHINAUD
375.description: So our assumption is Zoraal Ja somehow opened that gate to another reflection, where he acquired advanced technology and his mechanical army?

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003480_KOANA
376.description: It fits. And if he did, then it's also likely that the dome is a product of this unknown reflection.

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003490_ERENVILLE
377.description: Hold on. We've been going on and on about reflections, but what of my home? What's become of it?

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_A6_000_002_NONE_VOICE
380.description: This looks like a job for the Scions of the Seventh Dawn!

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003500_ALPHINAUD
381.description: Indeed. Where it concerns other realities, I daresay the Scions are best suited to tackle the task.

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003510_ALISAIE
382.description: You can say that again! We've been to the literal edge of existence. Some mysterious giant dome shouldn't scare us!

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003520_YSHTOLA
383.description: As you know, our order has ostensibly disbanded. We'd thank you to be discreet about our unofficial reunion.

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003530_GRAHATIA
384.description: Worry not, we'll spare no effort to get to the bottom of this. And with our hero eager to help, you can be confident of the results!

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003540_WUKLAMAT
385.description: I'm coming with you. If that's where my brother is, then that's where I must go.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003550_WUKLAMAT
386.description: I can't say I understand everything you're discussing, but I know what I have to do.

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003560_WUKLAMAT
387.description: I have to put a stop to Zoraal Ja, and restore the people's happiness!

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003570_KOANA
388.description: Suffice it to say I share Lamaty'i's desire to join you. However, under these circumstances, it would be unwise for both Vows to be absent from the city.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003580_KOANA
389.description: As such, I shall remain in Tuliyollal.

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003590_KOANA
390.description: Come what may, I will protect our nation. So go forth, Sister, and do what you must.

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003610_ALPHINAUD
392.description: It may be prudent for us to likewise divide our forces. While one group ventures into the dome, the other keeps guard without.

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003620_YSHTOLA
393.description: Agreed. There's something I wish to investigate out here, so I will remain.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003630_ALPHINAUD
394.description: I as well. The enemy's warships still loom overhead, and I would see that we're prepared for the worst.

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003640_KRILE
395.description: I wish to go to the dome.

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003650_KRILE
396.description: As a Student, I have an obligation to investigate this potential threat to the world.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003660_KRILE
397.description: But I'd be lying if I said I'm not deathly curious about my origins. If there's aught to be learned, then I want to learn it.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003670_ERENVILLE
398.description: In that case, please let me come too.

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003680_ERENVILLE
399.description: I have to see what's become of my home. I may not be a fighter, but I know those lands like the back of my hand. I can guide you.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003690_WUKLAMAT
401.description: If you hadn't offered, I would've asked. We're counting on you!

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003700_ALISAIE
402.description: I'm not one for waiting around, so if it's all the same to you, I'll join the dome crew.

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003710_YSHTOLA
403.description: You should accompany them, G'raha. I expect your knowledge and experience will be useful.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003720_YSHTOLA
404.description: In the meantime, I intend to learn what I can about the gate, and will keep you apprised of my findings. Pray do the same.

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003730_GRAHATIA
405.description: Assuming communication is possible from inside the dome, we'll maintain contact and share any developments.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003740_ALPHINAUD
406.description: It seems our teams are assembled. A fine roster, I think.

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003750_ALISAIE
407.description: Looks good to me. We'll find a way to deal with the threat─for the sake of Tural!

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003760_WUKLAMAT
408.description: It's truly heartening to have you at our side for this. Thank you, everyone.

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003770_WUKLAMAT
409.description: Now, before we set off, there's one thing I need to do. The people are still shaken by the attack, and I'd like to reassure them as best I can.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003800_WUKLAMAT
412.description: I'm ready for it. The fear and sadness and anger─everything.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003810_KOANA
413.description: I am the reason to your resolve. But more than that, I am your brother. You needn't bear this burden alone. Remember this.

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003820_WUKLAMAT
414.description: As you likely already know, my father, our former Dawnservant, lost his life in the recent attack.

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003840_WUKLAMAT
416.description: He challenged the enemy leader to a duel and fought with skill and valor. And for a moment, we believed he had won.

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003850_WUKLAMAT
417.description: But wielding an unknown power, his foe returned from death and struck him down.

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003860_WUKLAMAT
418.description: I could only watch as this happened. I could not tarnish my father's honor by interfering.

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003870_WUKLAMAT
419.description: Many of you have suffered terribly. You've taken wounds. You've lost friends and family.

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003880_WUKLAMAT
420.description: As Vow of Resolve, I failed in my duty to protect you. Words can't express the shame and regret I feel.

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003890_WUKLAMAT
421.description: And as much as it pains me to reveal this, the enemy leader was none other than my brother Zoraal Ja.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003920_WUKLAMAT
424.description: We believe he staged the attack from Yyasulani, which has been encased within a mysterious dome. I know that you're concerned for your loved ones there as well.

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003930_WUKLAMAT
425.description: But mark my words: I won't let Zoraal Ja torment us any further. Our father gave his life to protect our nation, and I'm prepared to do the same.

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003940_TONAWAATAUQMALEAUDA
426.description: You say that, but those metal monstrosities are still up there in the sky! What are you going to do about them!?

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003950_WUKLAMAT
427.description: The enemy is still on our doorstep, and waiting for them to strike again accomplishes nothing.

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003960_WUKLAMAT
428.description: That's why we're going to strike first. We're going to take the battle straight to Zoraal Ja and put an end to it all.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003970_KOANA
429.description: And while my sister sallies forth, I will take charge of the city's defenses. Not another soul will come to harm, we swear to you.

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_003980_WUKLAMAT
430.description: Like our father before us, we will lead with resolve and reason to restore peace to our nation. So please, have patience and faith.

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004000_BAKOOLJAJA
432.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)So the resolve goes on the attack while reason shores up the defenses... Sounds like a fine plan.

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004010_BAKOOLJAJA
433.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Needless to say you can count on my sword. Tural's my home, and I'll do my part for it!

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004020_BAKOOLJAJA
434.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Hear, hear, Brother!

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004030_BAKOOLJAJA
435.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)That makes two of us! Er, or was that two of we? Bah, never mind that.

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004040_BAKOOLJAJA
436.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)What of the rest of you? Will you let others do the work? Or will you do your part and fight!?

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004050_HANUHANUMALEAUDA
437.description: We fight, we fight! We're Tuliyollans because we're united! We'll stand with you and weather this storm!

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004060_TONAWAATAUQMALEAUDA
438.description: He's right. This is our nation and it falls to us to protect it.

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004110_KOANA
443.description: We've already learned much about our foe, and we will continue to learn more. In time, we will have the means to make their warships fall from the sky.

444.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004120_KOANA
444.description: When we join hands with our countrymen and our allies from afar, we're stronger than we dare to hope!

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004130_KOANA
445.description: Together, let us show the enemy the might of Tuliyollal!

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004140_WUKLAMAT
446.description: You are the beating heart of our nation. Each and every one of you!

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004150_WUKLAMAT
447.description: Uncertain days lie ahead, but for now I ask you to persevere. To go about your lives as you always do.

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004160_WUKLAMAT
448.description: Only then can we ensure we have the resources to see our nation through these trials.

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004170_WUKLAMAT
449.description: And when the time comes, we will strike!

450.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004180_WUKLAMAT
450.description: Tuliyollal will not fall! We will prevail, and peace and happiness will be ours again!

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004190_NITOWIKWE
451.description: Right, we're just about done with the modifications. But I have to stress that we cannot afford a test run.

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004210_WUKLAMAT
453.description: It's fine─we understand and accept the risks. We have faith in you and your craft.

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004220_WUKLAMAT
454.description: I'm sure everything will go to plan. With all the hard work everyone's put in, it couldn't be otherwise!

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004240_SHENZA
456.description: Behold, the pinnacle of locomotive engineering─the Dawnblazer!

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004260_ZAWPYA
458.description: Yep, she's been fitted with wooden armor and a crystal grounding rod to mitigate the effects of lightning. Naturally, we had to overhaul the engine so it could handle the extra weight.

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004270_GRAHATIA
459.description: I also had her outfitted with aetheric cannons, the better to contend with enemy forces. And as they're modeled upon those used at the Crystarium, I can attest to their potency.

460.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004280_WAWLIKA
460.description: So, what do you reckon? Given the tight turnaround, I'd say we did a damn good job.

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_A7_000_001_NONE_VOICE
462.description: This is the toughest locomotive I've ever seen!

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
463.description: Let them try and stop us in this.

464.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_A7_000_003_NONE_VOICE
464.description: It's a shame we have to blow her up...

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004290_WAWLIKA
465.description: Glad she's to your liking. I hate to let go of such a beautiful piece of machinery, but I know you'll give her a proper send-off for us.

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004300_ALISAIE
466.description: At the risk of spoiling the mood, we should probably get moving.

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004310_WAWLIKA
467.description: Yep. You won't get far if you let 'em pummel you from the air, but you'll be safe enough once you reach the tunnel.

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004320_GRAHATIA
468.description: In that case, I will conceal the train with a spell once everyone is on board.

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004330_GRAHATIA
469.description: It should last long enough for us to reach the tunnel unnoticed.

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004350_WAWLIKA
471.description: We've done all we can. Rest is up to you.

475.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004390_GRAHATIA
475.description: At this speed, we should arrive at the dome in no time at all!

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004400_ALISAIE
476.description: But not before we're spotted, I expect. Stay alert!

482.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004460_KRILE
482.description: Have care! They've switched to firearms!

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004500_WUKLAMAT
487.description: Erenville! I need you to take over for me!

493.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004560_KRILE
493.description: At last, the enemy stronghold... We should hurry before they can regroup.

494.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004570_WUKLAMAT
494.description: Let's go and find out what's inside!

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004580_ERENVILLE
495.description: What greeted us was not the home that I had left behind.

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004590_ERENVILLE
496.description: There was no mistaking we had reached Yyasulani, and yet...

497.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004600_ERENVILLE
497.description: It was wholly unlike my memories. The lands of my childhood had changed beyond imagining.

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004620_ERENVILLE
499.description: We tread on, the darkened skies above a mirror to my heart. Clouded with fear and uncertainty.

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004640_WUKLAMAT
501.description: This cannot be Yyasulani, can it?

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004650_ERENVILLE
502.description: My home... It's in ruins. But why─what happened here?

504.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004670_KRILE
504.description: I had a look in a few of the other houses, but they had clearly been abandoned.

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004680_WUKLAMAT
505.description: Damn it all! None of this makes sense!

506.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004690_SPHENE
506.description: (-???-)Excuse me... Are you looking for someone?

510.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004730_SPHENE
510.description: (-???-)I apologize for giving you a fright. However, I did have reason to keep to the shadows.

511.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004740_SPHENE
511.description: (-???-)Zoraal Ja has told me a great deal about you.

513.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004760_SPHENE
513.description: (-???-)Greetings, and welcome to the realm of Alexandria.

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004770_SPHENE
514.description: I am Sphene, the Queen of Reason.

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004790_GRAHATIA
516.description: If you are the Queen of Reason, is there perhaps a...?

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004800_SPHENE
517.description: Yes─if you mean to ask if there is a King of Resolve. Zoraal Ja holds that title, and together do we reign.

518.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004810_WUKLAMAT
518.description: Then you're both behind the attack on Tuliyollal!

519.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004820_ALISAIE
519.description: And I doubt you're here to offer us a warm reception.

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004830_SPHENE
520.description: No, you have it all wrong. I am not come to fight.

521.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004840_SPHENE
521.description: Zoraal Ja rules alongside me, but that is a matter of expedience. In truth, we are at odds, he and I.

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004850_SPHENE
522.description: It is at considerable risk to myself and my people that I come before you to beg your aid.

523.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004860_WUKLAMAT
523.description: Our aid? I'll admit I cannot imagine King Zoraal Ja is keen to share and share alike, but if what you say is true, you're still the queen.

524.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004870_SPHENE
524.description: ...Indeed. But I was once the sole ruler of Alexandria.

525.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004880_SPHENE
525.description: Until, one day, he appeared, bent on conquest. In my weakness, I feared his power...

526.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004890_SPHENE
526.description: So I persuaded him to forego violence and strike a bargain. I would remain queen, and he would receive technology that would empower him to achieve even loftier ambitions─along with the knowledge to use it.

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004900_SPHENE
527.description: A gamble, to be sure, but if it might spare my people...

528.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004910_KRILE
528.description: If I may─the dome surrounding these lands was erected but recently.

529.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004920_KRILE
529.description: How is it he was able to not only invade, but instate a new system of leadership in a mere matter of days?

530.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004930_ERENVILLE
530.description: I've never heard of your realm. And this place is─or at least, was─Yyasulani.

531.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004940_ERENVILLE
531.description: The house I grew up in is still here.

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004950_ERENVILLE
532.description: But three years ago, that tower and these strange contrivances weren't. Nor was our village in ruins.

533.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004960_ERENVILLE
533.description: Where did you come from, and what happened to the people who lived here? You must know!

534.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004970_SPHENE
534.description: I realize how confusing this all must be. Truth be told, I don't fully understand it myself.

535.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004980_SPHENE
535.description: What I can say is that, one day, people from your Tuliyollal suddenly appeared here in Alexandria. Or perhaps it was we who found ourselves in Tuliyollal...

536.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_004990_SPHENE
536.description: Until but recently, we were completely unaware of events taking place beyond the barrier surrounding our realm.

537.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005000_GRAHATIA
537.description: Does this not remind you of the Crystal Tower? How after the Eighth Umbral Calamity, we devised a means to transport the spire across time and space from the Source unto the First?

538.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005010_GRAHATIA
538.description: Granted, this is on a much larger scale, if that is indeed what has happened. Not only the people and structures, but also the surrounding environment...

539.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005020_GRAHATIA
539.description: Regardless, the people of Lakeland perceived the arrival of the Crystal Tower much as the queen describes her own experience─sudden and inexplicable.

540.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005030_SPHENE
540.description: Well then. You appear to have a better grasp of our circumstances than we do. Indeed, more than I dared hope.

541.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005040_SPHENE
541.description: In which case, a closer examination of the effects of this phenomenon may afford us more insights. Allow me to take you to the outskirts.

542.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005050_SPHENE
542.description: A number of the Shetona live there as well. Perhaps your acquaintances are among them.

543.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005060_ALISAIE
543.description: Hold on. If we accept, there's no guarantee we're not walking into a trap.

544.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005070_WUKLAMAT
544.description: But if we're to defeat Zoraal Ja, we need to understand how he grew so strong. Besides...

546.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005090_WUKLAMAT
546.description: Queen Sphene? Before we go, Your Majesty, I have to ask. Did you really have nothing to do with the attack on Tuliyollal?

547.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005100_SPHENE
547.description: Noble Wuk Lamat─shall we dispense with the formalities?

548.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005110_SPHENE
548.description: I'll not deny the soldiers and airships that attacked your people are products of Alexandria, but it was Zoraal Ja, not we, who fashioned them into weapons of war and laid siege to Tuliyollal.

549.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005120_WUKLAMAT
549.description: So he alone is to blame.

550.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005121_SPHENE
550.description: ...No. I may not have prosecuted this war, but I nevertheless bear responsibility for it.

551.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005122_WUKLAMAT
551.description: Perhaps. I know next to nothing about you, let alone what you've been through.

552.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005123_WUKLAMAT
552.description: So by all means─show us around. I think we'll learn a lot from meeting your people.

554.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005130_SPHENE
554.description: Wonderful! If you would follow me.

556.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_A8_000_001_NONE_VOICE
556.description: I take it there will be trouble if Zoraal Ja hears of this.

557.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_A8_000_002_NONE_VOICE
557.description: Isn't it a little odd for the queen to be walking about on her lonesome?

559.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005150_SPHENE
559.description: If things should take a turn for the worse...

560.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005160_SPHENE
560.description: Might I call upon your aid?

561.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005170_SPHENE
561.description: I jest, of course! But you do strike me as the most capable here.

562.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005180_SPHENE
562.description: Here we are! Though you'll doubtless find much of what you see in Alexandria strange, the traditional agriculture practiced in this village, at least, should be familiar.

563.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005190_PAKWENE
563.description: (-Amiable Resident-)Queen Sphene! What business brings her here, I wonder.

566.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005220_SPHENE
566.description: And Ketonye, I see you've already taken to your new position.

567.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005230_ALISAIE
567.description: When she introduced herself as queen, I was expecting someone...colder. Honestly, she reminds me of you, Lamaty'i.

569.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005250_SPHENE
569.description: It's only natural for a ruler to love her people.

570.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005260_SPHENE
570.description: And I should like to know them as best I can─even the most trifling details.

571.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005270_WUKLAMAT
571.description: The more you come to know them, the more you grow to love them. Who they are, and what they've built.

573.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005290_KRILE
573.description: And it would appear that she is well loved in turn...

574.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005300_PEPOANE
574.description: (-Affable Townsman-)Your Majesty, you honor us with your presence!

575.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005310_PEPOANE
575.description: (-Affable Townsman-)And who are these fine people?

576.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005320_SPHENE
576.description: Tuliyollal's Vow of Resolve, Wuk Lamat, and her companions.

577.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005330_SPHENE
577.description: They come from beyond the barrier, but you needn't worry. They are good people, and are to be treated as my honored guests.

578.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005340_PEPOANE
578.description: (-Affable Townsman-)The rumors of a link to the outside are true, then! Wuk Lamat is still so young...

579.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005350_PEPOANE
579.description: Ah, where are my manners? I am Pepoane─a leader, of sorts, of the people living out here.

580.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005360_ERENVILLE
580.description: Pepoane? That has a Tonawawtan ring to it.

581.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005370_PEPOANE
581.description: Right you are! I take it you hail from this region as well? Tesh'pyani, perhaps?

582.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005380_ERENVILLE
582.description: Yes, I do. I don't suppose you know a woman by the name of Cahciua?

584.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005400_PEPOANE
584.description: Hmm... I'm afraid I'm not sure if I've ever met someone with that name.

585.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005410_ERENVILLE
585.description: Mother isn't here... But it's a relief to know at least some of the people of Yyasulani are alive and well.

587.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005430_SPHENE
587.description: Now that you mention it, I do see the resemblance.

590.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005460_ERENVILLE
590.description: Then tell me, please─where is she?

591.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005470_SPHENE
591.description: ...I cannot say. Not here. But I promise I will in due time.

592.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005480_WUKLAMAT
592.description: I have a question, Pepoane. Do you recall what happened the day the dome first appeared?

594.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005500_PEPOANE
594.description: I remember fixing a shelf that had collapsed after a terrible earthquake. Then the ground began to tremble, there was a brilliant flash of light, and...then...

595.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005510_PEPOANE
595.description: Forgive me. My recollection of it all is rather poor.

596.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005520_SPHENE
596.description: You needn't push yourself, Pepoane. After thirty years, no one could blame you for not remembering.

597.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005530_WUKLAMAT
597.description: Thirty years!? As in thirty years in the past?

598.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005540_SPHENE
598.description: Absurd though it may sound, there is no doubt in my mind the events that led to the joining of our lands occurred thirty years ago.

599.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005550_SPHENE
599.description: Which is not to say I understand why our perceptions of the intervening time are so radically different. We only just became aware of the discrepancy, when Zoraal Ja's military base was completed, and we were at last able to venture beyond the barrier.

600.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005560_ZORAALJA
600.description: (-Zoraal Ja-)I believed you long dead. To have the chance to kill you myself is an unforeseen blessing.

601.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005570_WUKLAMAT
601.description: Thirty years... Little wonder Zoraal Ja assumed our father had already passed away.

602.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005580_GRAHATIA
602.description: It's not unlike how time passes differently in the First and the Source─the fluctuating space of the rift between them disrupting temporal equivalence.

603.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005590_GRAHATIA
603.description: Perhaps the same holds true here, and time flowed faster within the dome.

605.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_A8_010_001_NONE_VOICE
605.description: Meaning this is a piece of another reflection?

606.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_A8_010_002_NONE_VOICE
606.description: Do you suppose time is still passing faster in here?

607.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005591_GRAHATIA
607.description: I cannot say for certain, but I strongly suspect that to be the case.

608.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005592_GRAHATIA
608.description: I was able to make contact with Y'shtola not long ago via linkpearl, so that shouldn't be cause for concern.

609.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005600_GRAHATIA
609.description: And based on the queen's account, this encampment may have come to serve as a physical bridge between the two planes, after which the dome was forced into the Source's temporal flow.

610.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005610_ALISAIE
610.description: If we're to be certain of anything, we need more information.

611.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005620_ALISAIE
611.description: Sphene, would it be all right if we had a look around and spoke with the townspeople?

613.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005640_ALISAIE
613.description: Time to see what we can see of Alexandria, then.

614.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005650_ERENVILLE
614.description: And its people. I may yet find familiar faces among the survivors from Yyasulani...

615.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005660_WUKLAMAT
615.description: Even if I don't understand the half of it, I would learn more of this place before we confront Zoraal Ja.

616.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005670_PEPOANE
616.description: Perhaps you'd care to see how we make our living?

617.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005680_PEPOANE
617.description: Though we have always prided ourselves on the use of traditional Tonawawtan farming methods, the use of electrope-fueled technologies has led to countless agricultural innovations.

618.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005690_SPHENE
618.description: I would join you as well!

619.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005700_PEPOANE
619.description: Ma'am, please, you needn't trouble yourself.

620.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005710_SPHENE
620.description: It's no trouble at all. And I promise not to cause any manner of distraction.

621.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005720_PEPOANE
621.description: Reassuring words─or they would be had I not heard them countless times before. Very well, but do be careful.

622.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005730_SPHENE
622.description: Of course! I shall proceed with the utmost care.

623.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005740_SPHENE
623.description: Now, then. If you two would follow me, we can begin the tour!

624.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005750_WUKLAMAT
624.description: I can't say that I trust her yet, but I trust that her affection for these people is genuine. And that's enough for me.

627.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005780_PEPOANE
627.description: I'm glad you could make it.

629.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005800_OUTSKIRTSCAREGIVERA
629.description: Queen Sphene has come to see you.

630.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005810_SPHENE
630.description: We're here, Namikka. Everything is going to be all right.

634.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005850_WUKLAMAT
634.description: That's the bangle I gave to Namikka!

636.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005870_WUKLAMAT
636.description: Of course I know her. She was like a mother to me...

637.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005880_SPHENE
637.description: I see. She was always willing to lend a kindly ear to others, but rarely did she ever speak of herself.

639.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005900_KRILE
639.description: She must have arrived shortly before the barrier manifested. For us it was perhaps days, but for her...

641.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005920_PEPOANE
641.description: I'm afraid her time with us is nearly at an end...

642.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005930_OUTSKIRTSFARMERB
642.description: Has she no more soul cells?

643.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005940_OUTSKIRTSFARMERA
643.description: She always used hers sparingly, but at her age? It wouldn't make a difference.

645.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005960_SPHENE
645.description: Thank you, Namikka, for your many years of friendship. Take comfort in the knowledge that this is not the end.

646.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005970_SPHENE
646.description: Be not afraid. Your memory will live on in us.

647.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005980_ALISAIE
647.description: Living on in memory... The giants share a similar belief.

648.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_005990_WUKLAMAT
648.description: Wait! Where are you taking her!?

649.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006000_SPHENE
649.description: Worry not. She is being escorted to a medical facility in the tower. There we will ease her burden.

650.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006010_SPHENE
650.description: I had hoped to make arrangements for her sooner, but she wished to remain here for as long as possible. I could not bring myself to refuse her.

651.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006020_WUKLAMAT
651.description: Is there any way I might stay with her for a little while longer?

652.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006030_WUKLAMAT
652.description: We may not share the same blood, but...she was my mother. Please...

653.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006040_SPHENE
653.description: Let us give them some time alone.

654.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006050_WUKLAMAT
654.description: She didn't speak, but I'm grateful that I could be with her at the end. Thank you.

657.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006080_SPHENE
657.description: Oh, nothing. I was just thinking that we have much to discuss. Where shall we begin?

658.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006090_GRAHATIA
658.description: With what we can be reasonably certain of, perhaps.

659.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006100_GRAHATIA
659.description: Between what we have witnessed and the testimony of Alexandria's inhabitants, it's safe to say that two distinct lands have indeed become one.

660.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006110_GRAHATIA
660.description: What's more, having met Namikka, there is no denying the divergence in the passage of time.

661.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006120_GRAHATIA
661.description: Taken together, these phenomena strongly suggest that some manner of cross-rift displacement has occurred.

662.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006130_GRAHATIA
662.description: Specifically, the displacement of Alexandria from another reflection to the Source.

663.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006140_KRILE
663.description: It does seem the most likely explanation.

664.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006150_GRAHATIA
664.description: What perplexes me, however, is the scale of said displacement. It far exceeds what could conceivably be achieved with a voidgate, or even with the Crystal Tower.

665.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006160_GRAHATIA
665.description: In essence, we are dealing with a localized instance of dimensional compression. The Ascians would no doubt liken it to a Rejoining.

666.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006170_GRAHATIA
666.description: Which invites the question: how was such a feat accomplished?

667.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006180_SPHENE
667.description: ...I wish that I had an answer for you, but this talk of reflections and dimensions is well beyond my understanding.

668.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006190_SPHENE
668.description: I can only tell you that we lived peacefully under the barrier's protection for many, many years, until the day that peace was suddenly broken.

669.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006200_KRILE
669.description: If I may clarify─the barrier predates Alexandria's displacement?

670.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006210_SPHENE
670.description: By several hundred years, yes. To when the continent we call home was ravaged by a devastating cataclysm.

671.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006220_SPHENE
671.description: The barrier was erected to isolate us from the surrounding land's nocuous influence.

672.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006230_KRILE
672.description: I see... And it was only later that it was whisked away, along with its contents, by means unknown.

673.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006240_WUKLAMAT
673.description: In other words, Sphene's as lost as the rest of us, right? The Alexandrians didn't mean to end up in Tural.

674.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006250_SPHENE
674.description: ...Ah, but of course! Our next stop ought to be Everkeep. That tower over yonder.

675.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006260_SPHENE
675.description: Once you have been registered as my guests, you will have access to Solution Nine and its residential district, where you will doubtless gain invaluable insight into Alexandria's state of affairs.

676.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006270_SPHENE
676.description: Unfortunately, I cannot take you directly to where Zoraal Ja resides...

677.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006280_WUKLAMAT
677.description: That you'd let us in at all goes a long way toward proving you're not content to let Zoraal Ja do as he pleases.

678.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006290_WUKLAMAT
678.description: But we're not talking about a simple difference of opinion here.

679.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006300_WUKLAMAT
679.description: I've come to avenge my father, and to do so, I intend to take Zoraal Ja's life. Are you willing to stand by and allow Alexandria's king to be slain?

681.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006320_SPHENE
681.description: Permit me to answer it thus. My people come first. Their welfare is paramount.

682.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006330_SPHENE
682.description: I will do everything in my power to keep them from harm.

684.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006350_SPHENE
684.description: Now, I am off to register you at Everkeep. It may take some time, but you shall find the entrance open to you in due course.

685.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006360_SPHENE
685.description: Oh, and ere I forget... Your mother, Cahciua. You might try the Thunderyards to the east.

686.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006370_ERENVILLE
686.description: The Thunderyards? Is that where she is!?

687.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006380_SPHENE
687.description: I'm afraid I can say no more than that. Make for the Thunderyards, and all will be made clear.

688.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006390_WUKLAMAT
688.description: It's not as if we have other pressing business. Not until we can get into this Everkeep, anyway.

689.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006400_WUKLAMAT
689.description: Thank you for earlier...and for being a friend to Namikka these past thirty years. It means a lot to me.

690.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006410_PEPOANE
690.description: Namikka...? I'm sorry, but I don't know who you mean.

691.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006420_WUKLAMAT
691.description: What? We were just with her! If this is some sort of a joke, it isn't funny.

692.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006430_PEPOANE
692.description: I don't mean to give offense, but...I honestly have no idea who you are talking about. I'm sorry.

693.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006440_ALISAIE
693.description: How can you not know who she is?

694.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006450_ALISAIE
694.description: You're in charge here! She was under your care!

695.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006460_PEPOANE
695.description: Then in all likelihood, my memories of her have been stored in the cloud.

696.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006470_PEPOANE
696.description: Any person seemingly forgotten without reason is probably there. In the cloud.

697.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006480_PEPOANE
697.description: Oh, I really must be getting back to work. If you'll excuse me...

702.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006530_CAHCIUA
702.description: (-Unidentified Floating Object-)Elene'shpya? It really is you!

705.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006560_CAHCIUA
705.description: (-Unidentified Floating Object-)I just had to get a look at you in the light─and I can still hardly believe my eyes! But it is you, my darling Elene'shpya.

707.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006580_CAHCIUA
707.description: (-Unidentified Floating Object-)Oh, it's so good to see you, my fussy little bunbun. But what are you doing here? What brings you all this way?

712.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006600_CAHCIUA
712.description: (-Unidentified Floating Object-)Why the long face? Aren't you happy to see me after all this time?

713.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006610_ERENVILLE
713.description: I'd know that laugh anywhere... Mother?

714.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006620_WUKLAMAT
714.description: Wait, wait, wait! Since when was your mother a weird...floating thing!?

715.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006630_CAHCIUA
715.description: (-Unidentified Floating Object-)And what have we here? Say, aren't you Gulool Ja Ja's kitten?

716.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006640_CAHCIUA
716.description: (-Unidentified Floating Object-)I knew I recognized that adorable fuzzy face! Elene'shpya was always sooo excited whenever you invited him over to play. You remember me, I hope?

717.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006650_WUKLAMAT
717.description: I can't say that I do... But you knew my father?

719.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006670_ERENVILLE
719.description: Appearances notwithstanding, it would seem this is my mother, Cahciua.

721.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006690_CAHCIUA
721.description: Oh, but this won't do! Come in, come in! Friends of my Elene'shpya are always welcome...

722.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006700_GEODE
722.description: (-Blue-haired Man-)All I ask is a little forewarning, but no!

724.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07003_006720_WUKLAMAT
724.description: Just when I thought I was starting to get a handle on this place. How are things still getting stranger?
